sense.text:
This is the last day of the feast of unleavened bread, the season we were delivered out of ancient Egypt. When the Lord delivered us out of ancient Egypt he brought plagues on Egypt, and it will be the same thing again in these last days, when he delivers us out of spiritual Egypt, which is America: the same plagues that fell on the ancient Egyptians, on another technological level. The curses of Deuteronomy 28 that were on us in Egypt follow us here in America; now come the plagues.

It starts with Abram. “Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee.” God told Abraham to leave his family’s house and where he was, and he would take him to a land. Where Abraham was before was Ur of the Chaldeans, ancient Babylon. God told him to leave Ur of the Chaldeans and go to a land he would give unto him and his descendants.
“And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great”: the Lord would make of Abraham a great nation and make his name great.

“And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee”: God blesses them that bless Abraham and curses them that curse him.

“In thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.” The all families is Israel, scattered throughout the four corners of the earth. From the beginning the Most High was prophesying Israel being scattered throughout the four corners of the earth, because the Lord knew what would happen to us.

precepts.why:
“Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.” That is the land the Lord promised to give unto Abraham and his seed: the land of Canaan. “But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the Lord exceedingly.”

The Lord told Abram to lift up his eyes and look “northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.” He would make his seed “as the dust of the earth”, and told him, “Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.” Then Abram removed his tent and dwelt in the plain of Mamre.

So the Most High is promising Abraham this land. But there were already people in the land when God promised it to Abraham and his seed: the Canaanites, the descendants of Canaan. Why would God give it to Abraham? Abraham’s seed is the chosen seed, the righteous seed: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, the twelve tribes of Israel. And Israel was not just taking a land that belonged to another people. No.

Before the flood, the sons of God were living in that land. That is the land the creator of the heaven and the earth gave unto Adam; Adam was there and his sons, the sons of God, were there. When they became wicked, God flooded the earth. After the flood Shem stayed in Ur of the Chaldeans, where Abraham was. But Canaan went back to the land and settled it; Shem did not. Shem is the chosen lineage the sons of God came back through, and when the sons of God came back, the Lord gave them back the land they were dwelling in before the flood. That is what it is about.

sense.text:
Abraham is now in the land of Canaan, and the Lord comes to him in a vision. He has already told him he will multiply his seed, but he lets him know: “thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs.” That land is ancient Egypt. How did it happen? Jacob and his sons went down into Egypt because of the famine, and they sojourned there. That is what the Lord was letting Abraham know.

“And shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years”: four hundred years we would be afflicted in Egypt.

“And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge”: the nation we served was ancient Egypt, the Egyptians, and God judged that nation. He brought plagues on them.

“And afterward shall they come out with great substance.” That proves this is ancient Egypt, not America in the future. Are we coming out of America with great substance? No. We ain’t taking nothing from this place, nothing from Babylon. But when we came out of ancient Egypt, we came out with much substance, with silver and with gold.
“And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age”: Abraham was going to die, going to his fathers in peace, and die old.

“But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again”: Abraham’s seed, afflicted and coming out with great substance, would come back again to the land of Canaan, where the Lord appeared unto Abraham. We did it under Moses and Joshua; we were delivered and went back into the land, after the four hundred years, four hundred and thirty or so.

The fourth generation here is not genealogical: it is not your kids, not your great-great-great grandkids. If it were descendants, seventy went down into Egypt, and four descendants each is only about two hundred and eighty. How long would they be afflicted in Egypt? Four hundred years. And they come back in what generation? The fourth. Four hundred years, four generations: in this context one generation is a hundred years. The verse above explains it. That is a societal generation. Every hundred years society changes and everybody you know is dead, because the Most High gives most people seventy years to live, eighty with strength.

“For the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.” The Amorites were one of the sons of Canaan, in the land when Abraham was there. The Lord is letting Abraham know that when his descendants come back after four hundred years, they will destroy the Amorites and the sons of Canaan out of that land. At that time their wickedness was not full. God is not evil, killing people for no reason. When he brought us back, he told us to leave nothing alive, because by then their wickedness was filled: they were killing, sacrificing babies, murder, all type of evil in that land. God said, I am bringing my armies out after four hundred years, and my armies will destroy them out of that land.

precepts.why:
This is what came out with great substance. “And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: And the Lord gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.”

We took all of that from the Egyptians. We spoiled them. That is us coming out with great substance, out of ancient Egypt.

“He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.” God smote all the firstborn in Egypt.

“He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.” When we came out of Egypt, the Lord brought us forth with silver and with gold. That is the great substance of Genesis 15:14, and it shows the Egypt there is ancient Egypt.

What does “the fourth generation” mean? “After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, even four generations.” The generation here is his descendants: he saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, four generations. “So Job died, being old and full of days.” He died a hundred and forty years old, and he was able to see his fourth generation.

That is genealogical generation: me, my son, my son’s son, my great-great-grand. Some people live to see their great-great-great-grand. So is the fourth generation of Genesis 15 talking about descendants? If it were, seventy people went into Egypt; four descendants each is about two hundred and eighty. It is not talking about that.

“Thou shalt have no other gods before me. Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image”, “Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me”.

God visits the fathers’ sins upon the children unto the third and fourth generation: his descendants, his kids. That generation is genealogical. So the fourth generation there does not equal four hundred years, and that is not the generation Genesis 15:16 is speaking of.

There are genealogical generations in the scriptures, and there are societal generations. “Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.” A new king going into a new kingdom. “And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we”: the seventy souls had multiplied like crazy.

Why would a new king rise up that did not know Joseph? A lot of time went by. Joseph was dead, and everybody who knew what Joseph and the Israelites did for Egypt had died. It was a new society, a new kingdom. The king didn’t know who the hell Joseph was, nor the greatness Joseph did in Egypt. There was a society change.

That is societal generation. In the next hundred years everybody born around my time will be dead, and society will change. Everybody that was around in the 18th century is dead; everybody that was around in the 1900s is dead, and society has changed. A couple years ago we could not go into a restaurant and sit down and eat; society changed. So when a king rose up that knew not Joseph, Joseph died, everybody he knew died, there was a societal change, and Israel had multiplied.

“He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days. I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.” God’s years go throughout all generations. Those generations are not each kid; they are different societies and times.

“Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands. They shall perish, but thou shalt endure”: the generations perish, but God endures. “All of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed”: generations change. One point of time the Persians ruled this earth, then the Babylonians, then the Greeks, then Britain; now America rules the earth. Those were different time frames and different generations. You, your moms, your brothers, your cousins will all die one point of time, and another generation and another society will rise up, as when the generation that knew Joseph was gone and nobody honored Joseph and his people the same way.

“But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.” God does not change. “The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.” So the fourth generation of Genesis 15:16 is societal: four generations, four hundred years.

Why does the Lord say “the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full”? The Amorites were Canaanites, one of the sons of Canaan, living in the land; Canaan went back to the original land where the sons of God had lived.

“The portion of Jacob is not like them”: our portion is not like the other nations’ portion. “For he is the former of all things”: all things belong to us, and we were before all things. “And Israel is the rod of his inheritance”: we are the ones God uses to judge the earth. “Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms”.

With Israel he breaks in pieces “the horse and his rider”, “the chariot and his rider”, “man and woman”, “old and young”: eighty or ninety years old, or two, four, five years old. “The young man and the maid”, “the shepherd and his flock”, “the husbandman and his yoke of oxen”, “captains and rulers”. That is what the Bible is saying.

So God says after the fourth generation he will bring them back into the land, because the sins of the Amorites were not yet full: they were going to do a bunch of wickedness, and Israel would be his battle axe against them.

“But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.”

When God delivered us out of Egypt, he was not just delivering a people. He was bringing out an army. An army to do what? To break captains, men, young men and maidens, as Jeremiah 51 says. That is why he says that in the fourth generation he will bring them back into the land, because the sin of the Amorites is not yet fulfilled. By great judgments God brought forth his armies.

This is why God brought out his army: Joshua went into the land, took Jerusalem, and we conquered the whole land, to judge the nations. With us, the rod of his inheritance, he judges the nations and keeps justice and righteousness on this earth. That is our job.

People say, damn, the Israelites just went and killed everybody; why would God allow that? Because these people did much evil against God. When the Lord sent us to conquer the land, it was his judgment on everyone in that land for all their wickedness. God’s army was not just going around killing everybody for no reason. “When thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace unto it.” Ask them: you all want peace or you all want war? If it make answer of peace and open its gates, “all the people that is found therein shall be tributaries unto thee, and they shall serve thee”: make them pay taxes to you. In Joshua the Most High hardened their hearts so that they would say, we don’t want peace, that the children of Israel would destroy them, because they were wicked.

“And if it will make no peace with thee, but will make war against thee, then thou shalt besiege it”, and when the Lord delivers it into thine hands, “thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword”: young and old. “But the women, and the little ones, and the cattle”, all the spoil, thou shalt take: they became servants. That is for the cities “very far off from thee”, not the cities of the Amorites and the Canaanites.

“But of the cities of these people, which the Lord thy God doth give thee for an inheritance, thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth: But thou shalt utterly destroy them; namely, the Hittites, and the Amorites, the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites”. Nothing that breatheth means shepherds, sheep, maidens, young men, old men, women, children, babies. That is what we did when we went into the land, and God commanded it.

Why? That land belonged to God. “That they teach you not to do after all their abominations, which they have done unto their gods; so should ye sin against the Lord your God.” They were doing much abomination in the land, and that is why the Lord wiped them out. He is the same God that drowned everybody on the earth with a flood because of their wickedness. These were the descendants of Canaan; they knew what they were supposed to be doing, but they went into evil in the land. Leave them alive, and you will follow their ways and sin against God.

sense.text: “And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand. And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof”. God said he would stretch out his hand and smite Egypt with all his wonders, and God stretched out his hand and smote Egypt with plagues. That is what God did.

precepts.why: “And the Lord said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt”. The wonders brought upon Pharaoh and Egypt are called plagues. God brought plagues upon ancient Egypt.

God took him a nation from the midst of another nation “by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors”. Those signs and wonders are the plagues.

The same way the Lord brought us out of ancient Egypt by signs, wonders, war and great terrors, it is the same way he is going to bring us out of this spiritual Egypt we are in, America: with terror, signs and wonders, which is plagues. It will be the same thing over again, and the one doing it is the Lord.

sense.text:
“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships”. The Egypt with ships is the transatlantic slave trade: us being brought into the Americas and this side of the world. It is the last curse that fell upon the Israelites, that they would go into slavery in another Egypt, another house of bondage and oppression, this time on ships. It happened in the 1600s: you were brought here on cargo slave ships.

“Thou shalt see it no more again”: Moses is saying this is not ancient Egypt. “And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen”: taken off the slave ships, sold to your enemies as slave men and slave women.

“And no man shall buy you”: nobody will be able to redeem you, buy you back out of that house of bondage, that oppression and affliction. The scripture says Christ bought us with a price, and he is the one that redeems us. Only Christ can redeem us from this place, from this spiritual Egypt.

precepts.why:
This proves the Egypt of Deuteronomy 28:68 is America. “And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city”: the dead bodies are the Israelites, dead because we don’t know who we are; we are in a dead state of mind, having left from keeping God’s laws. The great city is America, Mystery Babylon the Great.

“Which spiritually is called Sodom”: the abomination of the earth, where sodomy goes on, where they legalized sodomy. This place is spiritual Sodom. “And Egypt”: this place is spiritual Egypt because the Israelites are enslaved and oppressed here in America the same way they were in ancient Egypt. It is spiritually the land of oppression, the land of bondage, the land of slavery: what our forefathers experienced in ancient Egypt, they experienced here in America and wherever those ships took them.

“And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” That great city is Mystery Babylon the Great, America, and America is the abomination of the earth. So the great city of Revelation 11:8, spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, is America.

sense.text: “Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world”. The same way God brought plagues on ancient Egypt, he is going to bring plagues on this new Egypt, spiritual Egypt, which is America. “The sword, famine, death, and destruction”: that is what you see beginning right now. What we are living in is the beginning of sorrows, when the Lord has started to send his plagues on the earth.

“For wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth”: everywhere you look is war, murder and much wickedness, lies pushed all over this earth.

“And their hurtful works are fulfilled.” It is the same thing as Genesis 15: their wickedness is fulfilled. The Lord leaves nations to do their wickedness a long time, but once that wickedness is fulfilled he brings forth plagues and his judgment, and he sends his sons forth to bring judgment and justice on the earth. Right now it starts with us teaching and prophesying, but when our king returns it will turn into another thing. As the Lord delivered his army out of Egypt, he is going to deliver his armies out of America.

“I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness”: all the wickedness Esau is doing on the earth.

“The innocent and righteous blood crieth unto me”: they are going to make war with the saints. They will try to come against us; future prophecy says they will kill a lot of us here in America, brothers who believe this Bible and are doing what is right, and put a lot of us in prison.

“And the souls of the just complain continually”: you die and you are with the Lord, and you are complaining, asking for judgment and vengeance.

“I will surely avenge them”: whatever the government plans to do to us, God will come and avenge us for everything they did: for slavery, for Jim Crow, for all the evil done to us over these centuries. He will “receive unto me all the innocent blood from among them”.

“Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt”. This Egypt is America, modern day Egypt: the Egypt of Deuteronomy 28:68, where the Lord brought us again with ships.

“But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before”: the same way he did it in Exodus. According to Bible prophecy, God will smite America, spiritual Egypt, with plagues, the same way he smote ancient Egypt. This is not the Egypt of the past; it is an Egypt in the future.

“And will destroy all the land thereof.” Was all the land of ancient Egypt destroyed? No. This Egypt’s whole land will be destroyed by the plagues he sends: America.
“Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen”: Babylon is destroyed. Babylon the great is that great city spiritually called Sodom and Egypt. So Babylon the great, spiritual Egypt, is destroyed.

“For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: America jacked them up. “And the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies”: that is how China got rich, how Saudi Arabia and all these nations got rich. First it lets you know Babylon is destroyed; now it is letting you know why and what happened.

“Come out of her, my people”: this goes back to before Babylon is destroyed. Who are God’s people in Babylon? The slaves of verse 13. To come out of her is to deliver your soul and not be cut off in her iniquity: don’t take part in the sins of spiritual Egypt, Mystery Babylon the Great.

“That ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” There are plagues coming here to Babylon, to the place 2 Esdras calls Egypt. The same way God plagued ancient Egypt, when the Lord comes to deliver his people he is bringing plagues on this place. If you partake in the sins of America, follow the white man as Jesus Christ and savior, get caught up in their politics and their religions, you are going to receive of her plagues.

So, brothers and sisters, we have to come out from spiritual Egypt, from Mystery Babylon the Great, come out from her sins, the lies, the philosophies, the politics and the religions of America, and deliver our souls.

“For her sins have reached unto heaven”: the Most High sees and hears all the evil they are doing. “And God hath remembered her iniquities.” You all want to forgive and forget; some of you say slavery was in the past. But God does not forget. God remembers how she stole this land from the North American Indians, the bomb they dropped on Japan, how they brought us here as slaves and oppressed us, Jim Crow, the lynchings, every last drop of our blood shed here. Now he is bringing judgment for all the evil they have done throughout centuries, because their wickedness is fulfilled.

“Reward her even as she rewarded you”: that is payback. “And double unto her double according to her works”: Mystery Babylon the Great, spiritual Egypt, will get double. “In the cup which she hath filled fill to her double”: she will drink double of what she is doing to everyone.

“How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her”: there will be torment and sorrows in this place. You don’t want to get caught up in the plagues coming to Babylon.

“For she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow”: I won’t lose no citizens. “And shall see no sorrow”: nothing is going to happen to me. That is what the US government thinks. Hear how Trump talks: we got the strongest military in the world. Zelenskyy went to the White House and said, soon it is going to come to your door, and they said, don’t say that. The pride of their heart has deceived them.

“Therefore shall her plagues come in one day”. In ancient Egypt the plagues came many different times, but the plagues coming to modern-day Egypt, spiritual Egypt, all come in one day, one hour. “Death, and mourning, and famine”: there will be food shortage in America. “And she shall be utterly burned with fire”: that is one of her plagues, and the fire is nuclear fire. “For strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.”

All the plagues of Revelation 16, all the plagues of Egypt, the darkness, the water turning to blood, the famine, the death, the noisome sore, the fishes in the sea dying, the water becoming radioactive poison, come upon America in one day. There are other plagues that will take place on the earth that build up to it: what you see happening to the nations now, America bringing judgment on them, the wars. At the end of that build-up, Babylon will be destroyed. We don’t know the year, the month, the day or the hour, but we can tell how close it is.

The stones falling from heaven are nuclear bombs too.

What are God’s people doing in Babylon? To show it, the class jumped to verse 11: “And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more”, and from there to her merchandise in verse 13.

Among her merchandise, “and slaves”. Where did the slaves in Mystery Babylon the Great come from? From Deuteronomy 28:68, the transatlantic slave trade. One of the commodities Mystery Babylon traded in was slaves. So the people God commands to come out from amongst her in verse 4 are the slaves that are here: the Israelites brought here into spiritual Egypt as slaves.

“And souls of men”: they also sell souls of men here.

precepts.why:
How do they sell souls in Mystery Babylon the Great? “Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul”. That Babylon is Mystery Babylon the Great, and it is your soul the Lord wants you to deliver out of here.

“Be not cut off in her iniquity”: that is saying the same thing Revelation 18:4 is saying. If you get caught up in the sins here in Babylon, in her iniquity, you are going to destroy your soul. That is what it means that she sells souls.

“For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?” America promised a lot of you the world. America sold you a dream, a lot of us came here seeking that dream, and a lot of you sold your soul for that American dream: to become rich, for vanity. That is what Revelation 18 means by her buying and selling slaves and souls of men.

You gain everything in America, the nice house, the nice job, but you had to break God’s laws to obtain them, so you lost your soul. You agree with the homosexuality, with the fornication, with all the sins of America. You agree with Christianity; you are a Christian, following the white man and his religions. America says, I can make you rich, but you got to support homosexuality, become a Christian, worship the white man and the image of the beast, and you can get anything you want. Just follow Satan. That is what it really means: you are worshipping Satan, and that is how America sells souls and how you lose yours.

“Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul? For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels”.

This proves that those who partake of her sins will be caught in her plagues. “For now are the plagues come upon the whole earth, and ye shall remain in them”: you that break God’s laws will remain in those plagues. “For God shall not deliver you”: the wicked of our people will not be delivered from them.

“Because ye have sinned against him.” Why would you remain in the plagues and not simply die? Because your name is blotted out of the book of life, and you are going to be tormented. You think it is just the nuclear bomb alone that is the plagues coming here? There are levels to what this is saying.

sense.text: “Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.” Those four angels are all the armies of the earth with their nuclear weapons.

“Which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men”: to kill two and a half billion people, the third part of men. Will the army gather and everything happen in one day, one hour? What this is really going into is America being destroyed. The build-up of that war, its climax, is America destroyed: in that year there is a month, in that month a day, in that day an hour, when all of Babylon’s plagues come on her. It will take the nations one hour to destroy this whole land.
“The number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand”: two hundred million soldiers.

“And thus I saw the horses in the vision”: what he sees in the vision is a modern-day military, and he explains it as best he can. He calls it a horse because he cannot explain what it is, but he knows it is war. “Having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone”: that is the tanks. “And the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions”: when you look at a tank, it looks like a lion. “And out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone”: the prophet sees fire and smoke coming out of the head. What he is seeing is World War III, the army that will kill two and a half billion people on the earth.
“By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.”

“For their power is in their mouth”: that is the tank. “And in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents”: that is the missiles they shoot off from their trucks; when the missile comes forth from the tail and flies in the sky, it looks like a serpent. “And had heads, and with them they do hurt”: that is the warhead, where the explosion is. Some of the warheads are nuclear; some are just TNT explosions.

“And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands”: even during World War III they will not change and will not repent, because when Christ returns they are going to come to fight against him. “That they should not worship devils”: that is the white Jesus you are worshipping, the devil. “And idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood”.

“Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts”: none of them, America nor Britain, will repent, nor of the lands they steal.

“The temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened”: the tabernacle of the Lord was opened. “And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.” These are the seven archangels, and they came out with seven plagues.
They were given “seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.” Those plagues are the wrath of God.

“And no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.” The seven plagues, the wrath of God, have to be fulfilled. The Lord said, I will smite Egypt with plagues as before: these seven plagues are the plagues the Lord is bringing on America. And Revelation 18 says, come out of her, my people, that ye receive not of her plagues, and in one hour her plagues come: death, destruction, famine.
“Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.” Here are the same plagues God brought on ancient Egypt, and he is going to bring them on America in one hour.

“And there fell a noisome and grievous sore”. Noisome means foul smelling and harmful, extremely offensive to the senses, particularly the smell: a real nasty sore. What could make a man like that? A nuclear bomb. It causes severe radiation burns, blistering, open sores and deep, long-lasting ulcers. When a nuclear bomb goes off, if the blast does not kill you, you are going to be rotting, your skin falling off, and it will be noisome.

“Upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.” How do we know this is that one hour of that one day, the nuclear bomb falling on America? The sore falls only on those who have the mark of the beast and worship his image. So where are we? We are delivered. It is not going to fall upon us, because the Lord will deliver us. This is talking about what happens after a nuclear bomb’s fallout.

“And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man”. This is Mystery Babylon, Babylon the great, being destroyed: the Lord sending on America the same plagues he sent on Egypt, all in one hour. “And every living soul died in the sea”: this is war on the sea, nuclear bombs going off in the ocean, nuclear war.

“And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.” When it says they became blood, it means they became poisonous, radioactive. Nobody could drink it.
“Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus”: because God judged America and turned the drinking water into blood.

“For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets”: in America they will kill the saints and prophets; this is going to happen in the future. “And thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy”: the Lord gives America nuclear, poisonous water to drink. When that bomb goes off, some people hide in their little fallout shelters. Those the blast does not incinerate die from noisome sores, and those that go drinking the water die from drinking poisonous water. Those are the plagues the Lord is bringing on America, in one hour. That is why the scripture says come out from amongst her, my people.
“Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments”: true and righteous is God’s judgment for the plagues he is sending on Babylon.

precepts.why:
The Lord told Moses and Aaron, “Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh. And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.”

One of the plagues on Egypt was boils on all the people, man and animal. That is the plague the first vial brings again on spiritual Egypt, the noisome and grievous sore.

This is what noisome means, from Antiochus: “the worms rose up out of the body of this wicked man, and whiles he lived in sorrow and pain, his flesh fell away, and the filthiness of his smell was noisome to all his army.”

What could happen to make men get like that? A nuclear bomb explosion causes severe radiation burns that lead to intense itching, blistering and open sores, coming in stages, then deep, long-lasting ulcers. When the bomb goes off, those it does not kill will be rotting, their skin falling off, and it will be noisome, like Antiochus.

This explains why that sore falls only on those who had the mark of the beast and worshipped his image. “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty”: if you dwell in the secret place of the Most High, you dwell in his shadow, his protection. “I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”

“Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.” That is the first plague, the noisome pestilence, and the Lord will deliver us from it. This plague comes in that one hour, and we will be delivered from it and protected.

Another plague that fell on Egypt: “And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.” All the fish in the river died, and they could not drink of the river because there was blood all over the land.

That is what happened in ancient Egypt, and the Lord said, I will smite Egypt with plagues as before. The second and third vials are the same plague on America.

This explains the blood they will drink. “As it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea”: that great mountain burning is America. “And the third part of the sea became blood”: the same plague that was on Egypt. “And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died”: as all the fishes died in ancient Egypt, it will be the same on the shores of America. “And the third part of the ships were destroyed”: the Abraham Lincoln and all their navy carriers will be destroyed in the sea.

“There fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters”: nuclear bombs dropping on the rivers here in America. “And the name of the star is called Wormwood”: look up wormwood in Ukraine, in the Ukrainian language, and it is Chernobyl, the nuclear accident. So this star is a nuclear weapon hitting the rivers.

“And the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter”: made poisonous, toxic. That goes back to Revelation 16:6: they are worthy, thou hast given them blood to drink, nuclear poisonous water. All of it happens in one hour.

“Thou shalt see after the third trumpet”: we just read of the third trumpet, the sea and the waters hit with nuclear bombs and the fishes dying. That is nuclear war. “That the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night, and the moon thrice in the day”: how does the sun shine in the night, or the moon shine bright in the day? It is bombs going off in the night and in the day. A nuclear bomb going off in the night looks like a sun. That is what the prophet is explaining.

“And blood shall drop out of wood, and the stone shall give his voice, and the people shall be troubled”. When that happens, Christ returns. When the bombs go off, he is coming. The radioactive waves, the noisome pestilence, the bloody, poisonous nuclear water will not harm us, because we will be delivered out of here. During that one hour, when the bombs are falling, it will not come near us.

“And the Sodomitish sea shall cast out fish”. All creatures in the sea shall die. Why the Sodomitish sea? Sodomites are Sodom and Gomorrah, and Revelation 11:8 says the great city is spiritually called Sodom: the great city is Mystery Babylon the Great, spiritual Sodom. It is letting you know Egypt is being destroyed.

The Sodomitish sea is the seashores of America. All the fish there are going to die from a nuclear bomb going off in the sea and destroying the ships, as Revelation 8:8 says. You will go to the shores and all you will see is dead fish, from radiation. These are the plagues coming to modern day Egypt, America, the same thing that happened in ancient Egypt when the fishes in the river died. The Bible is no fairy tale book.

“The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt”. The Egypt he is talking about is America, and he is coming to deliver us. “And the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.”

“And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.” That is one of the plagues that happens before that one hour comes: the white people in America will be fighting each other. There will be civil war here.

“And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up”: the rivers wasted with nuclear bombs. “And they shall turn the rivers far away”: they will try to go to rivers far away, probably Antarctica or something like that.

“And the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up”: the brooks of defence are where they store their water, the dams, the water reserves. The other day Trump was talking about the reserve water that should have been allowed to go to California, that would have stopped the fire. There will be no water here. “The reeds and flags shall wither”, and “every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more”: everything by the river will die. This is a future apocalyptic event, what America looks like after that one hour.

“The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish”: because all the fishes in the sea die and the water in the beaches and the rivers is poisonous. “Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.”

sense.text: The next plague. “And the Lord did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.” The Lord killed all the cattle in Egypt, and killing the cattle caused famine. All the plagues that were on ancient Egypt, the Lord is going to bring on spiritual Egypt, America.

precepts.why: “Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail”. The locusts would eat all their crops. That is famine.

“And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the Lord rained hail upon the land of Egypt.” Hail and fire from the sky came down on ancient Egypt: “So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.”

“And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.” Every herb, every fruit tree in the field, and any man that was outside and not inside, all died from that hail and fire that fell from the heavens. That is what the Lord did in ancient Egypt, and he is going to do it again today. The cattle dying, the locusts and the hail all go into famine.

There is no hail the Lord is dropping on modern day Egypt: that hail is going to be nuclear bombs. “But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before”: the same way he smote Egypt in the past. “And will destroy all the land thereof”: the whole land of this Egypt destroyed with those plagues.

“Egypt shall mourn, and the foundation of it shall be smitten with the plague and punishment that God shall bring upon it”: the foundation of America is going to be smitten. This Egypt is America.

“They that till the ground shall mourn”: the farmers. “For their seeds shall fail through the blasting and hail, and with a fearful constellation.” When the nuclear bombs hit there will be no more farming, no more crops. Why a fearful constellation? A constellation is stars, and the Bible refers to the nuclear bombs as stars. They will fall and destroy all the crops, and nothing will grow any more. The earth, the trees, the sea, the rivers, everything is being hurt now.

sense.text: “Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.” That darkness was felt. The darkness in Egypt was not just the place getting dark; you could feel the darkness. The people were terrified.

precepts.why:
Darkness was upon Egypt, and so it is on the beast. “And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast”: the seat of the beast is America. “And his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain”: there was much pain going on. They were feeling that darkness.

“And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores”. The sores are the first plague we read about, the noisome sores.

“Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her”: cry for her. “Take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.” Balm is ointment. But you can’t heal this place. When the nuclear bombs drop, there is no healing this place: you got the sores, the pain; see if you can heal yourself.

“We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed”. This is coming into today: they want to heal Babylon today, trying to make America great again. But she is not going to be healed. She is going to be destroyed, and there is no ointment for the pains and plagues God is bringing upon her.

“And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.”

There is no light on the earth because the bombs are going off and the nuclear fallout cloud covers the sky. The sun is blocked out, the moon is blocked out, the stars are blocked out; bombs are going off all over the earth. All these plagues happen at the same time, in that one hour. How many thousands of bombs are they going to drop on this place?

“As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep”. The I is the Lord Christ. When he returns he will seek out his sheep, the house of Israel, the slaves scattered through all the four corners of the earth.

“And will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.” When the nuclear bombs go off, the Lord is going to be here, delivering us in that cloudy and dark day. “And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land”. That is the prophecy.

“The great day of the Lord is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly”: it is coming; you can see it, you can smell it. See what Trump is doing, the things that are happening. It is hastening greatly: time is speeding up. “The mighty man shall cry there bitterly”: these dudes that think they are tough and bad, you are going to cry bitterly, crying like a girl.

“That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness”: thick darkness all over America, all over the world. “A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers”: the protected cities. You are going to hear an alarm: nuclear bombs are coming. It will be all over the television, within one hour. That is the alarm.

“And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the Lord: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.”

“Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord’s wrath”: no matter how much money you are getting, it can’t deliver you when the Lord’s wrath begins and those plagues come into America. Those of you that are millionaires and billionaires, who see us doing the work and are saving up $10 million: help us with the work. Don’t be saving your riches up in this world.

“But the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.” Everybody that dwells in the land, he will get rid of them in a speedy riddance.

sense.text: “About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.” That is another plague: all the firstborn children in Egypt died.
“And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt”. Now that plague comes to America.

precepts.why: “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon”: not ancient Babylon but the daughter of Babylon, which is America, which is Edom. “Sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans”: there is no more throne for you. You are not going to be ruling any more, you white people.

“Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures”, “that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me”. Who is the I AM? God. You set yourself up as God; you say you are the people of God, and nobody can take you down. “I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children”: I am not going to lose no citizens.

But God says: “these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood”. That lets you know it is Babylon it is talking about, because the destruction of Babylon comes in one day, one hour. Nobody has ever attacked America on its soil; that is going to happen. You will lose your citizens. Everybody in this place is going to die: that is the loss of children, the plague of the firstborn come upon America. “They shall come upon thee in their perfection”: the Lord does it in perfection, “for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.”

“For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness”: America trusts in her wickedness. “Thou hast said, None seeth me”: you think nobody sees the evil you have been doing, but God sees it. “Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee”: it makes you stupid; you think you are God. “And thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me”: you started setting yourself up as God.

“Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the Lord, which destroyest all the earth”: the destroying mountain is America. “And I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain”: a burnt nation. “But thou shalt be desolate for ever”: that is the Bible prophecy. Babylon, spiritual Egypt, will be desolate for ever, and nobody will dwell here any more.

“Blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her”: the nations are being prepared to fight against the destroying mountain, America, Mystery Babylon the Great. That is what you see taking place with Iran, with Russia, with Europe; that is what Trump is doing. The nations will say, the hell with that, we are going to fight against America and shoot all our nukes and destroy America. “Ashchenaz” is the Germans. “Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes”: the Medes are Persia, Iran. All the rulers will be gathered together against America, “And the land shall tremble and sorrow” when they see all the armies come together.

“For every purpose of the Lord shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.” The purpose is to make this place desolate, with thermonuclear fire, with nobody inhabiting it. When those bombs go off, if you are alive you will have the noisome sore and die from radiation, and there will be no food here; it will be famine.

“The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds”: the mighty men of America will forbear to fight and remain in their bunkers. “Their might hath failed; they became as women”: after all the big bad talk they threw, that is what they became. “They have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.”

This fulfils God’s purpose against Babylon. “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast”: the ten horns are Europe, NATO, the European Union. At one time they were one with America and gave their power unto America, but right now Trump is talking about dismantling NATO. See what the prophecy says: they shall hate her, they are going to hate America, “and shall make her desolate and naked”, showing her shame, “and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” Europe and NATO will play their part in burning America with thermonuclear fire.

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will”: God will put it in the hearts of the Europeans to go to war with America, shoot nuclear missiles at America and destroy this place. “And to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled”: Europe gave their kingdom unto the beast nation, America. They formed the European Union, the UN, NATO. That is what is happening right now: they are starting to hate America because of what America and Trump are doing, and they will turn on America and burn it with thermonuclear destruction.

“And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.” That great city is Mystery Babylon the Great, the great city spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, that rules the whole earth.
